_comment: BIOS a platform genuinely needs, where the core's own .info does not say so.
Firmware is declared per core, but a core can span platforms with different needs. FBNeo
marks every one of its 23 entries optional, which is honest for arcade romsets and wrong for
Neo Geo: neogeo.zip carries the mandatory MVS BIOS. Nothing upstream can express that
difference, so the pair is named here instead.
Keyed by platform AND core, because two cores on one platform can differ. Geolith needed both
aes.zip and neogeo.zip and declared them correctly; FBNeo needs neither declared nor aes.zip.
'required' names files that must all be present. 'anyOf' holds groups, and a group is
satisfied by any one of its members: several cores accept a dozen interchangeable regional
BIOS dumps, and demanding all of them, or picking one and demanding that, would both be
wrong. A pair can need more than one group, since a core can want one BIOS and one of a
This only ever tightens what a core already declared. It cannot add a file the core does not
name, and cannot make a mandatory file optional. So a wrong entry here reports a working
